setup: Current-limited programmable USB source, battery emulator, instrumented candidate PCB; no actual lithium cell for initial sequence tests

cases.stimulus: Attach with MCU unpowered and R46 holding SEL low
Attach while MCU running from battery emulator; repeat SEL low and forced high test state
Sweep VBUS upward/downward across 1.08 V, 1.7 V and supervisor threshold at multiple ramp rates
Remove USB with high-budget selected and VBUS_LIMITED charged
Repeat short and long USB dips; monitor supervisor reset and input switch behavior

evaluation: While U16 VDD is within recommended range, compare D against 0..VDD and record excursions with probe uncertainty
Check absolute D bounds -0.5..VDD+0.5 at all captured instants; do not use survival as functional qualification
Record peak and integrated USB current before configuration and after suspend; compare against final applicable USB power budget
Below 1.08 V, do not infer switch state from truth table; verify that no hazardous or overbudget current results
Verify continuous recording remains intact through USB attach/detach when emulator has adequate energy

capture_screen_tool.scope: Sampled voltage-envelope screen only; does not cover all evaluation items
software_smoke_checks: Synthetic VBUS removal with D0.7V flagged
